stem: Dylan in “A Book for Jonah” and Zach in “Fruit for All” would most likely agree that —

options.label: A
options.text: children can help people more than adults can

options.label: B
options.text: using technology is the only way to inform people

options.label: C
options.text: schools should support people in the community who are in need

options.label: D
options.text: it is easier to accomplish a goal with the support of friends and family
